lines.t: He walked the earth in love and grace
The Word made flesh to take our place
He healed the sick, the blind could see
And cried, repent and follow me
Yahuwah gave His Son to die
That none be lost, that life draw nigh
No endless pain, no hopeless cries
The wicked perish, truth defies
I blotted out, gone forever
The proud shall fall, remembered never
From dust we came, to dust return
The fire refines, the chaff shall burn
But life he gives to all who hear
Yahushua's call, so strong, so clean
Come to the light, escape the night
No torment awaits
Just death or life
The dead know nothing
Still and cold
Not tortured flames
As we've been told
The wages paid for
Wicked wages
An end of breath
No song is
heard from the grave the lake of fire the second death where yahweh draws his gift of breath no
life in pain no scream no sore the soul consumed to be no more the early saints would never teach
a fiery hell no hand could reach they spoke the truth with steadfast tone the wicked fade
Their breath is gone
Yahushua weeps for those astray
He calls them home, He is the way
He warns in love, turn and be wise
For sin shall burn
Then flame shall die
Blotted out, gone forever
The proud shall fall, remembered never
From dust we came, to dust return
The fire refines, the chaff shall burn
But life he gives to all who hear
Yahushua's call, so strong, so clear
Come to the light, escape the night
No torment awaits
It's just death or life
So fear the one who gives and takes
Who wakes the soul whose mercy breaks
He longs to cleanse from every sin
But those who mock won't enter in
The book is open, hearts are weighed
The righteous rise, the lost shall fade
So choose the life He came to call
Receive His flame
Surrender all
Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
